focus_areas: Spatial separation between gondola and background trees (Depth/Fusion)
Existence and clarity of propeller/nacelle details
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the boundary between the bottom of the gondola and the tree line. Use the geometric depth auditor to confirm if they occupy the same spatial plane (melting). Also, use the open vocabulary detector to rigorously check for propellers; if they are missing, flag as a structural anomaly. Finally, verify if the text on the hull is coherent or gibberish.
image_description: A large, silver-grey airship (dirigible) hovering low over a body of water with a dense tree line in the background. The airship features a long, cigar-shaped envelope with advertising text on the side and a gondola suspended beneath the forward section. The underside of the gondola appears to visually merge or bleed into the background trees.
